paite: Huai khit in diabol khem a om ding in gamdai ah Kha pilut in Jesu a-omta hi.
heading: Jesu Khemna / (Mar 1.12-13; Luk 4.1-13)
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

paite: Huan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli an angolh nung in agil hong kialta hi.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

paite: Khempa ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suangte tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawtte in ahing zaw ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

paite: Huai zoh in, diabol in kho siangthou ah apilut a, Pathian tempul tungzum ah akoih a,
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

paite: akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh kikesak in; 'Na tungthu ah a-angelte thu ape ding a, akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding,' chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n chih gelh ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

paite: Huan diabol in tang sangtak ah api nawn a, khovel gam tengteng leh athupina a-ensak hi.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

paite: Huan akiang ah, "Bokkhup in hon bia in, hiai tengteng ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Setan, hiai a kipan paimang in, Toupa na Pathian na biak ding, ama nna kia na sep ding ahi chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

paite: Huai zoh in diabol in apaisanta a, ngai in, angelte'n amah nna ahong sepsak uhi.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

paite: Huan Johan aman uh chih Jesu'n azak phet in, Galili ah akihemkhia hi.
heading: Galili Gam A Jesu Nasep Patna / (Mar 1.14-15; Luk 4.14-15)
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

paite: Nazaret khua apaisan a, Kapernaum ah a-om nilouh a, huai tuh Zebulun leh Naphtali uk, tuipi gei a om ahi a,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

paite: zawlnei Isai kam a thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi:
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

paite: "Dil lam a, Jordan gal a, Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, Zentelte Galili gam a,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

paite: mial nuai a tute'n vak thupi amu ua, sihna lim nuai a tute tung ah vak ahong suakta,” chi a agen hong tuntheihna ding in.
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

paite: Huai hun a kipan in Jesu'n, "Kisik un! Van lalgam anaita," chi in thu agenta hi.
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

paite: Huan Galili Tuipi gei a avak kawm in, unau nih Simon Peter kichi a-unau Andru toh, tuipi ah len pai lai amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
heading: Ngamanmi Lite Sapna / (Mar 1.16-20; Luk 5.1-11)
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

paite: Huchi in alente uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai zel a unau dang nih, Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan, apa uh Zebedai kiang a long a alente uh bawlpha in amu a; amaute asam hi.
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

paite: Huchi in long leh apa uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

paite: Jesu'n asinagogte ua thu hilh in, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, mite natna chiteng leh hatlouhna chiteng hihdam in Galili gam tengteng ah apai vialvial hi.
heading: Jesu Thuhilh Leh Nasepna / (Luk 6.7-19)
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

paite: Siria gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta a, akiang ah mi damlou tengteng damlouhna leh natna chih thuakte, dawimatte, kaih veite leh zawte ahon pi ua, ana hihdam hi.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

paite: Galili gam a kipan, Dekapolis a kipan, Jerusalem leh Judia a kipan leh Jordan gal a kipan in mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
